```plato
    //==
    // # IHashable — the Cartesian points
    //
    // Point2D and Point3D declare IHashable (points.types.plato) and so owe a Hash.
    // Folded component-wise with the shared CombineHash (hashing.library.plato),
    // exactly as the vector twins in `vectors.library.plato` are: two
    // points that compare equal therefore hash equal within a run.

    // The combined hash of the two coordinates.
    Hash(self: Point2D): Integer
        => self.X.Hash.CombineHash(self.Y.Hash);
```

```plato
    Hash(self: Point3D): Integer
```

```plato
    //==
    // # VectorN

    // Folds component hashes in index order.
    Hash(self: VectorN): Integer
        => self.Components.Reduce(0, (acc, x) => acc * 31 + x.Hash);
}
```
